summary: Post-claim validation rejected the allocator recovery hint before substantive mutation. This fixture is explicitly generation-1-specific: its mission requires fresh workers to contend on deterministic G000001 and its definition of done counts four G000001 loser collision receipts. A recovery G000002 cannot satisfy that mission and would distort the contention fixture. Generation 2 was reserved atomically but no execution claim, product mutation, collision fabrication or production promotion was performed.
tests: POST_CLAIM_SCOPE_CHECK: mission names deterministic G000001 only: PASS
NO_SUBSTANTIVE_MUTATION: no generation-2 execution claim or collision evidence created: PASS
NON_PROMOTION: no /w, Current, Served, champion or Human Accepted mutation: PASS
unresolved: The allocator currently exposes this generation-1 contention fixture as replaceable recovery work even though later generations cannot satisfy its fixed G000001 acceptance criteria. Recovery eligibility should eventually encode retry/generation semantics rather than liveness age alone.

spawn_candidates.title: Exclude generation-fixed contention fixtures from ordinary recovery
spawn_candidates.reason: A generation-1-only canary was offered as G000002 recovery even though its acceptance criteria cannot be satisfied by a new generation.
acceptance: Jobs whose mission/contract is fixed to a specific generation are not offered as ordinary next-generation recovery.
Their unfinished evidence remains visible without creating invalid successor ownership.
Normal retry-safe portfolio jobs retain existing recovery semantics.
